CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **TubeHaus**, a self-hosted YouTube client for the whole household: no ads, no tracking, no Google account, and one shared library (subscriptions, history, playlists, resume points) for every phone, computer and TV in the house. Source: https://github.com/biolend83/tubehaus (AGPL-3.0). Independent open-source software, not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
TubeHaus on Unraid is two containers that run together: **TubeHaus** (the server) and **TubeHaus-Web** (the web app you open in the browser). Install both.
Support: https://github.com/biolend83/tubehaus/issues
